description: Solar PV Production Forecast — Next 1-7 days of rooftop solar output (kWh per day, peak kW, best hour, percent of clear-sky, EXCELLENT/GOOD/FAIR/POOR) for a US location from National Weather Service hourly sky-cover and temperature forecasts plus an offline solar-position, clear-sky irradiance and plane-of-array model in 15-minute steps. Params: lat= and lon= (or place=), optional kw= system DC size (default 1), tilt= degrees (default 25), azimuth= (180 = south), losses= percent (default 14), days= 1-7. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_solar_forecast
